content: Isak edde Rebekah
Hẽtte Ibrahim bura edde boyoš beši oiye, ar Mabude hibare hár kissut duwa goijjil.
Ibrahime hibar góror šobsaite furan gulam, zar uwore hibattu aššilde hin beggunor hár bár aššil, hitare hodde, "Tor hattan ãr ranor tole rak.
Ãi tore behosto edde duniyair Allah, Mabudor sarme hosom gorai, ze Kenaniyo okkolor butore ãi bošobaš gorir, itarar butottu ãr futolla bou no anibi,
kintu ãr dešot ãr nizor egena okkolor hãse zai ãr fut Isakolla bou anibi."
He gulame hibare hodde, "Zodi he maya fuwa ãr fũwati ei dešot aite razi no o, henoile ze deš sari tũi eṛe aigiyogoi he dešot ki abar tũwar futore loizaiyum?"
Ibrahime hodde, "Kiyal rakis, ãr futore tui hono mote heṛe no loizais.

Mabud ze Behostor Allah, ze ãre ãr bafor gór edde ãr zormostanottu niyolai ainne, ze ãr loi hota hoiye edde hosom hái hoiye, 'Ei dešgan ãi tor bongšore diyum' hibaye tor age hibar firistare defeṛaibo, zene tui ãr futolla hentu ek bou ani faros.
He maya fuwa zodi tor fũwati aite razi no o, toile tui ãr hosomottu hedin azad; kintu hono mote ãr futore heṛe no loizais."
Toi he gulame hitar giros Ibrahimor ranor tole hat raki ei befare hibar loi hosom háiye.
Tarfore he gulame hitar girosor ũṭ okkolottu došwa ũṭ loi, hitar girose diyede hár ḍoilla dami zinišfati okkol loi baisa diye. Hite Aram Nahuriyamor mikka ruwana diyore Nahuror šohorot giye.
Hite heṛe šohoror baire uṭgunore ek fanir kuwar ḍake luṛai ejje; ar hiyan aššilde hazinna ṭaimot, zẽtte mayafuwainde fani tulito za.
Tarfore hite duwa gorer, "Oh Mabud, ãr giros Ibrahimor Allah, aijja ãre kamiyaf goro, edde ãr giros Ibrahimore doya dehao.
So, ãi ei fanir kuwar hãsat tiyai roiyi, ar ei šohoror mainšor ziyain okkole fani tulibolla niyoli aiyer.

Iyan endilla ok zẽtte ãi ek zuwan mayafuware hoi, 'Tor górawa lama, zene ãi fani fiyi fari,' ar hibaye ho, 'fiyo, ai tũwar uṭgunore o ãi fani diyum' henoile hiba tũwar gulam Isakolla tũwar basai gora ok. Ar iyanot ãi zaniyum ze tũi ãr girosore doya dehaiyo."
Ar so, ei duwa goijja no oite, Rebekah góra handot loi niyoli aiyer. Hiba aššilde Ibrahimor bái Nahuror bou Melkar fut Betuelor zi.
He zuwan maya fuwawa aššil beši šundori, ek kumari, zibare hono manuše no sue. Hiba kuwat laimme edde góra furai loi abar uwafes uṛi aišše.
Hen šomot gulammuwaye dũri hibar sarme zaiyore hodde, "Meherbani gori, tor górattu ãre ekka fani fito de."
Hibaye hodde, "Malik, fani fiyo," ar toratori górawa hibar handottu hibar hatot lamaiye edde hitare fani fito diye.
Ar hibaye hitare fani fito di bade hodde, "Ãi tũwar uṭgunolla o fani tuliyum, zetun hitara fani fiya šeš no gore."
Tarfore hibaye toratori hibar górar fanigun zanuwarore fani habade nor kulot ḍali diyore dũri abar kuwar ḍake fani tulibolla giye, edde hitar hár uṭ okkololla fani tuille.
Ar manušwaye nizamot hibar uzu saiye, Mabude hitar baisa kamiyaf goijje ne na ki no gore zanibolla.
Uṭgune fani fiya šeš oi bade, manušwaye adá šekel uzonor ugguwa šunar nakful, edde dui hatolla doš šekel uzonor duiyan šunar haru hibar sarme bair goijje.
Toi hite hodde, "Tui haro zi, meherbani gori ãre ho, tor bafor górot ãra rait haṛaibolla hono ekkan zaga ase ne?"
Hibaye zuwabe hodde, "Ãi Melkar fut Betuelor zi, zare Melkaye Nahurolla biyaiye."
Hibaye aro hodde, "Ãrar górot beša beši ker edde buši ase edde takibar zaga o ase."
Hetunot he manušwaye Mabudor soida foriyore šukuriya zanaiye,

ar hodde, "Hár tarif ãr giros Ibrahimor Allah Mabudore, zibaye ãr girosor mutallek hibar doya edde imandari dehare forai no fele. Ãre o fõtot, he Mabude rasta dehaiyore ãr girosor egena báiyor górot ainne."
Bade he zuwan mayafuwawaye dũri zaiyore hibar mar górot ei hota okkolore hoiye.
Ar Rebekkattu Labon name ek bái aššil, hite oi kuwar ḍake manušwar hãse dũri giye,
Hite zehon nakful edde hitar boinor hatot haru deikke, ar manušwaye hoilde hin hitar boine hodde funniye, hite niyoliyore he manušwar hãse giye, edde hite kuwar hãsat ũṛor ḍake tiyat lotfaiye.
Toi hite hodde, "Oh Mabudor rahamotwala manuš, aiyo! Baire kiyolla tiyai taikko? Ãi õnolla gór edde uṭgunolla zaga ṭik goijji."
Toi manušware górot ainne edde uṭgunottu fũza lamai loiye. Ar uṭgunore ker edde buši diye, ar manušwa edde hitar sãti mainšore ṭeng dúibolla fani diye.
Tarfore zehon hána ainne, hetunot manušwaye hodde, "Ãi ãr hota hoiya no o foijjonto ãi hána no háiyum." Toi Labone hodde, "Toile ho!"
Toi hite hor, "Ãi Ibrahimor gulam.
Mabude ãr girosore beša beši rahamot goijje, ehon hiba ekzon beši ḍõr manuš, ar hibaye hibare beši goru sool šuna rufa gulam edde bandi ar uṭ gada diye.
Ãr girosor bou, Saraye hibar ei bura boyošot ãr girosolla ek futore biyaiye. Hitare hibar nizor hár kissu difelaiye.
Ar ãr girose ãre endilla hoi hosom goraiye, 'Ãi zarar dešot bošobaš gorir, he Kenaniyo okkolor ziyain okkolottu ãr futolla bou no anibi,
kintu tui ãr bafor górot zaibi edde ãr nizor egenar butottu ãr futolla ugguwa bou anibi.'
"Tarfore ãi ãr girosore fusar goijjilam, 'Kintu mayafuwa zodi ãr fũwati aito no sa ka?'
"Hibaye ãre hoil, 'Ãi zar sarme sola fira gori he Mabude firistare tor fũwati defeṛaibo edde tor baisare kamiyaf goraibo, toi zene ãr bafor gór edde egena okkolor butottu ãr futolla bou ani faros.
Tui ãr egenar górot zai bade zodi hitara hibare no de toile tui ãr ei hosomottu azad.'
"Aijja ãi zẽtte kuwar ḍake aišši, ãi hoiyide, 'Oh Mabud, ãr giros Ibrahimor Allah, meherbani gori tũi ãr ei baisare kamiyaf goro.
Ar so, ãi ei kuwar ḍake tiyai roiyi. Hono zuwan maya fuwa zodi fani tulito aiye, ãi hibare hoiyum, "Meherbani gori, tũwar górattu ãre ekka fani fiyabo,"
ar hibaye zodi ãre ho, "Fani fiyo, Ãi tũwar uṭgunolla o fani tuliyum," henoile hiba he maya fuwa ok, zibare Mabude ãr girosor futolla basona goijje.'
"Ãr dilot ei hota howa šeš no oite, Rebekah góra handot loi, niyoli aišše. Hiba kuwat laimme edde fani tuille, ar ãi hibare hoidde, 'Meherbani gori ãre ekka fani do.'
"Hibaye toratori hibar górawa handottu lamaiye edde hodde, 'Fani fiyo, ar ãi tũwar uṭgunore o fani diyum.' Toi ãi fani filam, edde hibaye uṭgunore o fani diye.
"Bade ãi hibare fusar goijji, 'Tui haro zi?' "Hibaye hodde, 'Ãi Melkar fut Betuelor zi, zare Melkaye Nahurolla biyaiye.' "Toi ãi hibare nakot nakful, ar hatot haru findai dilam.

Tarfore ãi Mabudore sojida goriyore šukuriya zanaiyi. Ãi ãr giros Ibrahimor Allah Mabudore šukurana adai goijji, kiyollahoile hibaye ãre soiyi rastat loi ainne zene ãi ãr girosor báifutor ziyore hibar futolla loi zai fari.
Ehon õnora zodi ãr giros loi doya edde soiyi bebar goribolla razi aso, toile ho. Ar zodi no tako, hiyan o ho, henot ãi zene ar oinno hono mikka zai fari."
Toi Labon edde Betuele zuwab diye, "Iyan zehon Mabudor torfottu oiye; ãra tũware bala edde bura kissu hoi no farir.
So, otiya Rebekah, hibare loi zo, Mabude hoilde mozin hiba tũwar girosor futor bou ok."
Ibrahimor gulame zehon hitarar ei hota fuinne, hite meṛit fori Mabudor sarme soida foijje.
Tarfore he gulame šuna rufa guwana fati hor sour bair gori hinore Rebekare diye; ar bout dami ziniš okkol o hite hibar bái edde mare diye.
Toi hite edde hitar fũwati aššilde manuš okkol, hitara beggune há fiya goijje edde heṛe rait haṛaiye. Bade hitara binna sore uiṭṭe, hite hodde, "Ãi ãr girosor heṛe zaiboilla bidai do."
Kintu hibar bái edde maye hodde, "Zuwan mayafuware aro ašṭo, doš din antaz ãrar fũwati takok; tarfore hiba zaibo."
Ar hite hitarare hodde, "Ãre ar eṛe raki no diyo, Mabude zehon ãr sofor kamiyaf goijjede dekir; ãre bidai do, ãi ãr girosor heṛe zaigoi."
Tarfore hitara hodde, "Toi zuwan mayafuwaware ḍaki, hibar mukottu ekka funi sai."
Toi hitara Rebekare ḍaikke edde fusar goijje, "Tui ei manušwar fũwati zaibi ne?" Hibaye hodde, "Ãi zaiyum."
Toi hitara hitar boin Rebekah edde hibar dáimare Ibrahimor gulam edde hitar manuš okkolor fũwati defeṛaiye.
Hitara Rebekare duwa gorer edde hibare hor,

content.text: tor bongšo okkole odihar adai gorok

content: Bade Rebekah edde hibar bandi okkol tiyar oiye edde uṭ okkolor uwore sori manušwar fise fise giye; ar he gulame Rebekare loi giyegoi.
Ehon Isak Beer Lahai Roi kuwar hentu bai gil, kiyollahoile hiba Negevot takito.
Hazinna odde ṭaimot Isake ãṛat maze maṛot giye, ar hibaye uwor mikka sadde šomot dekedde hodun uṭ aiyer.
Ar Rebekaye o uwor mikka saiye edde Isakore deikke. Toi hiba uṛottu nise laimme
edde gulamware hodde, "Maṛottu ãṛi ãrar uzu aiyedde hiba honnuwa?" Toi gulammuwaye hodde, "Hiba ãrar giros." Toi hibaye gũwaṛa loiye edde nizore guijje.
Tarfore he gulame hite goijjilde hár kissu beggun Isakore zanaiye.
Isake hibare hibar ma Sarar ṭambut ainne, edde Isake hibare loiye, toi hiba bou oiye edde hibare Isake ador goijje; hibar ma mori bade, Rebekar adore Isakore šantona dil.
